component.name: Sele
component.summary: A focused desktop workspace for Codex

description.p: Sele is a desktop AI harness for working with Codex across local projects. It brings conversations, project context, code changes, file editing, and terminal sessions together in one focused workspace.
Review changes as you work, move between projects and conversations, and keep the tools needed for agent-assisted development close at hand.
The Flatpak uses host command execution so that Codex, Git, shells, and developer tools installed on the computer remain available to Sele.
